conversationLog.userMessage: how do we use the dashboard?
conversationLog.bellaResponse:
🐱 **HOW TO USE THE ADMIN DASHBOARD**

This dashboard gives administrators complete control over Valdez Elementary School's portal. Here is a comprehensive guide to all tabs and popup modals:

**1. Main Tabs & Sections:**
• **Dashboard**: Track overall metrics (Total Students, Repeaters, Dropouts, Classrooms, Teachers, Seats) for the selected School Year (S.Y.). Create or delete school years. Trigger the **Edit Census Stats** modal to adjust baseline statistics.
• **Calendar**: Post school-wide notices and events using the **Add Event** modal.
• **Teachers**: Search, edit, delete, or add new teachers. Assign teachers to specific grade levels and sections.
• **Students**: Roster of all students with advanced filters. Actions include editing details, deleting students, updating enrollment status, and viewing individual grade sheets. Add students using the **Add Student** modal.
• **Analytics**: Performance charts, average grades, and visual metrics comparing school years.
• **Accounts**: Search and update usernames or passwords for students, parents, teachers, and admins.

**2. Core Popup Modals & How to Trigger Them:**
• **Add Student Modal** (Trigger: Click "+ Add Student" on the Students tab): Enroll a new student and auto-generate login credentials (Username: LRN, Default Password: `password123`).
• **Add Teacher Modal** (Trigger: Click "+ Add Teacher" on the Teachers tab): Add a new faculty member.
• **Add Event Modal** (Trigger: Click "+ Add Event" on the Calendar tab): Post calendar events/announcements.
• **Compare Year Modal** (Trigger: Click "Compare Year" dropdown on the Dashboard tab): View side-by-side comparisons of different school years.
• **S.Y. 2020-2027 Export/Import Modal** (Trigger: Click "S.Y. 2020-2027 Export/Import" button): Backup or restore the entire database using Excel files.
• **Classroom Size Modal** (Trigger: Click "Classroom Size" button on the Dashboard tab): Visualizes student-teacher ratios (target 33:1) and classroom capacity warnings.
• **Edit Census Stats Modal** (Trigger: Click the "Edit Stats" button on the Dashboard card): Manually adjust baseline statistics for enrollment adjustments.

💡 **Tip**: If you want instructions for the Teacher or Student/Parent dashboard instead, ask me: "How do I use the teacher dashboard?" or "How do I use the student dashboard?" 🐾

🐱 **HOW TO USE THE STUDENT/PARENT DASHBOARD**

This dashboard is designed for students and parents to view student performance and records. Here is a detailed breakdown of the features available:

• **Grades / Academics**: Access detailed quarterly subject grades (Q1 to Q4) for Math, Science, English, Filipino, MAPEH, and Makabayan. Displays final averages and visual indicators (Passed/Failed).
• **Attendance**: Displays an interactive monthly attendance calendar highlighting present, absent, or late days.
• **Achievements**: View a list of certificates, medals, and academic awards earned.
• **Enrollment**: Access official student profile information (LRN, grade level, section, and enrolled dates).
• **Payments**: Financial records detailing school fees, tuition summaries, and payment history.
• **Medical / Health**: Digital clinic card detailing physical growth (height, weight), vaccination records, dental checkups, and consultation logs.
• **Report Card**: View, request, and print official report cards.
• **Help / Support**: Portal user guide, FAQs, and contact forms for administrative assistance.
